verdicts.tldr: the table's own defaulting makes it impossible for a case to pass the documented no-cap value to BuildPlan
verdicts.details: The subtest maps a zero tc.maxRealms to defaultMaxRealms at plan_test.go:132-135, so every one of the eleven cases calls BuildPlan with a positive limit and 0 never crosses the boundary. -max-realms is documented at main.go:73 as `cap on rendered realms; 0 for no cap` and implemented as the `maxRealms > 0` guard at plan.go:256, so the mode the flag documents is the one mode the table has designed itself out of reaching. Flip that comparison and -max-realms 0 truncates Realms to empty, turning every uncapped run into a preview of nothing with no error, and the suite stays green. Fix: make the table field a *int, or use -1 as the use-the-default sentinel, so a case can pass 0 through.
